name: OBRA Essentials
subtitle: Cones, GPS speed logger, 3D viewer and FarLink for Formula Student test days
description: Sideload source for OBRA Essentials, the Oxford Brookes Racing Autonomous iPhone toolkit: AR + LiDAR cone layouts, a GPS speed logger, a 3D file viewer and FarLink for FarDriver motor controllers.

apps.name: OBRA Essentials
apps.subtitle: Cones, GPS speed logger, 3D viewer and FarLink
apps.localizedDescription:
Oxford Brookes Racing Autonomous toolkit in one app.

• Cones: lay out Formula Student / FS-AI test tracks with AR + LiDAR. Skidpad, acceleration and CSV layouts, chained placement, saved sessions
• GPS: 10 Hz GPS + IMU speed logger with heatmap track, graphs, driver / run type / notes, Excel, CSV and GPX export, and several runs saved as one zip
• 3D: offline viewer for STEP, IGES, STL, DXF, OBJ, 3MF, glTF, Blender and more
• FarLink: dashboard, tuning and registers for FarDriver motor controllers over Bluetooth

Built for the iPhone 17 Pro Max (works on any LiDAR iPhone running iOS 18+).

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: OBRA Essentials uses the camera and LiDAR to show where each cone goes on the ground.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: OBRA Essentials uses GPS to record speed runs and to tag saved track layouts with the site location.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: OBRA Essentials uses the motion sensors and barometer for 10 Hz speed, g-force and elevation logging.
privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: OBRA Essentials uses Bluetooth in the FarLink tab to read and configure a FarDriver motor controller.
